item.title: Lindsey Vonn says surgery saved her from having left leg amputated
item.description: The 41-year-old Vonn said the trauma from the crash led to compartment syndrome in the leg.

item.title: BAFTA and BBC apologize for racial slur during awards show
item.description: The British Academy Film Awards and BBC apologized for a racial slur that was broadcast during Sunday's show while two stars of the film “Sinners” were onstage.

item.title: Peter Attia departs CBS News after communications with Epstein surface
item.description: Wellness and anti-aging doctor Peter Attia is leaving CBS News after communications he had with the late sex offender Jeffrey Epstein were brought to light, The Hill confirmed on Monday.

item.title: WATCH: Granddaughter surprises 80-year-old fighting cancer with classic car parade
item.description: An 80-year-old Colorado man got quite the surprise on Sunday afternoon, when dozens of classic car owners cruised past his home in a parade his granddaughter organized just for him.

item.title: Late Rev. Jesse Jackson to lie in state in South Carolina
item.description: The body of the late Rev. Jesse Jackson will lie in state at South Carolina's Capitol building next week, officials announced Monday.

item.title: Skiers dug out buried companions — heroic details emerge after fatal California avalanche
item.description: Officials released new information Monday detailing the heroic efforts of three skiers who managed to save several of their companions after the fatal avalanche near Northern California's Lake Tahoe.
